newsitem.title: NORWAY: POLL-Nera Q2 pre-tax seen up from Q1.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Nera Q2 pre-tax seen up from Q1.

text.p: Norwegian telecommunications company Nera ASA is expected to book a profit before tax of 28 million crowns in the second quarter of the year, a Reuters poll of eight analysts showed.
Nera posted pre-tax profits at 26 million crowns in the first quarter 1997 and at 29.8 million crowns in the second quarter 1996.
Five analysts recommended to buy Nera stock, while two said hold and one declined to provide a recommendation.
The majority of the analysts said the trend in Nera's markets had improved following a disappointing first quarter and the company is now in a period of growth.
"After the first quarter the focus on the company was on weak figures. Now the focus is on growth," said one of the analysts.

Another said: "I think there will be growth in both orders and revenues. After autumn I expect to see a repricing (of the share) such that Nera will be priced more in line with similar American companies."
"First Nera has must establish a trend which shows development on a firmer footing. As I see it now it (the future) can go either way," said one of the analysts with a hold recommendation.
The second analyst recommending hold said he was uncertain of the outlook for both margins and order intake.
